svg.title: Inside a pump-driven espresso machine
svg.desc: A cut-open machine shows a water reservoir on the left, an electric pump below it, a cylindrical brew boiler and heating coil in the middle, and a valve feeding the group head and coffee basket above a cup. A separate pipe returns from the three-way valve to the drip tray.
